name: UNDERSTAGE / Coelho Radioactivo
description: João Sarnadas, known as Coelho Radioactivo, presents his new album Anti-Ontem. The concert explores memory, emotions, and concerns about living in the present, examining relationships with time, others, and oneself.
longDescription:
João Sarnadas, performing as Coelho Radioactivo, presents his new album, Anti-Ontem, at TMP-Rivoli. The concert is scheduled for December 11, 2026, at 22:30, with a duration of 60 minutes. Tickets are priced at 7€.

Coelho Radioactivo, a project started by João Sarnadas in 2007, has released albums like Estendal and Canções Mortas, along with various singles and EPs. His 2026 album, Anti-Ontem, aims to capture a portrait of the present moment.

Sarnadas is also involved with other musical projects such as Flamingos, Well, Montanha, and founded José Pinhal Post-Mortem Experience. He has contributed to experimental and improvised music through Gentle Records and Favela Discos, where he became a release director in 2017. He has also composed for theatre and dance pieces.
